Ana: Quick pulse — token attribution roll-in. Where are we on event schema + latency samples? Need owners for `token.generate` and `token.billing`. @Mike @Tara :eyes:
Mike: PR opened for `token.generate` — #6423. Adds fields + examples. Waiting on codegen and a product decision about `region_hint`.
Tara: I can take `token.billing` ownership. If product OKs `region_hint` we can make it optional. @Sophia can you confirm semantics? :thumbsup:
Sophia: +1 to optional. `region_hint` helps routing attribution, won't change downstream joins. I can sign off tomorrow morning.
Kevin: I can own latency-breakdown sampling. Plan: run nightly sampler for 7 days, produce percentile table + hist, then push to /data/latency-samples/token. Adding a smoke test in `perf-checks`.
Mike: nice. I'll add a note in #6423 referencing Kevin's output location. Local repro command: ```python infra/tools/sample_tokens.py --date=2026-07-15 --out=./sample.json```
Ana: timeline check — product signoff by EOD tomorrow, schema PR merge by Thu, sampling completed by next Wed? Any blockers?
Tara: blocker: billing team wants `cost_center` field added to `token.billing`. That will need one extra DB column and a small mapper change. ETA +2 days.
Mike: ok noted. I'll update the schema to include `cost_center` optional and add migration ticket.
Kevin: sampling unaffected by that. I'll include `cost_center` in the sample schema if present.
Sophia: product will triage `cost_center` tomorrow morning; aim to keep optional.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: analytics-schema v1.7 -> canary on prod-analytics at 2026-07-17T03:00Z. Watch window 2h.
Ana: cool — owners and next steps: Mike (schema PR + migration ticket), Tara (billing event owner + follow billing team), Kevin (latency sampling + perf smoke), Sophia (product signoff). I'll ping infra-qa for a quick smoke after canary.
Tara: noted. I'll post a short checklist in the PR: migration steps, fallback plan, dashboard links.
Mike: pinging @infra-qa now. Also adding unit test for `region_hint` parsing.
Ana: thanks all. I'll update the project tracker: milestone -> schema merge Thu, canary Fri, sampling done Wed next week. If anything slips call it out here. :rocket:
